items.heading: Parliament Passed the National Nursing
items.text: Parliament passed the National Nursing and Midwifery Commission Act, 2023, which repeals the Indian Nursing Council Act, 1947 and will eventually replace the INC with the National Nursing and Midwifery Commission (NNMC).

items.heading: The Act Also Requires Every
items.text: The Act also requires every state to set up a State Nursing and Midwifery Commission where one does not already exist.

items.heading: Implementation Is Happening in Phases,
items.text: Implementation is happening in phases, and during this transition the existing legal authority and functions of the INC and current state nursing councils continue to operate.
